sectors_and_stocks.description: Identify top sectors by breadth and Stage 2 participation for today, with improving stocks.
sectors_and_stocks.query:
WITH latest_sector_breadth AS (
    SELECT s.sector, s.pct_above_50dma, s.change_5d, m.stage2_pct
    FROM breadth.sector_daily s
    JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above m ON s.snapshot_date = m.snapshot_date
    WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
), improving_stocks AS (
    SELECT symbol, sector, stage_score, trading_signal
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
    AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
)
SELECT lsb.sector, lsb.pct_above_50dma, lsb.change_5d, lsb.stage2_pct,
       ist.symbol
FROM latest_sector_breadth lsb
JOIN improving_stocks ist ON lsb.sector = ist.sector
ORDER BY lsb.stage2_pct DESC, ist.stage_score DESC
LIMIT 20;

synthesis_guidance: Focus on sectors with both high breadth engagement and high Stage 2 participation. Highlight stocks from these sectors that are showing strong buy signals.
title: Sector Breadth Rotation Watchlist Variant 1805
tool_plan_template: Filter sectors by latest breadth data and identify stocks with improving signals.
validation_rules: Ensure all sectors have a latest breadth snapshot.
Only include stocks with 'BUY' or 'STRONG_BUY' signals in Stage 2.

sql_templates.description: Fetch latest quarterly results and analysis with stage information
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_results AS (
                    SELECT DISTINCT ON (qr.symbol) qr.symbol, qr.period_end, qr.revenue, qr.pat, ra.verdict, ss.stage, ss.trading_signal
                    FROM scores.quarterly_results qr
                    JOIN scores.results_analysis ra ON qr.symbol = ra.symbol AND qr.period_end = ra.period_end
                    JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON qr.symbol = ss.symbol
                    WHERE qr.period_type = 'quarter'
                    ORDER BY qr.symbol, qr.period_end DESC NULLS LAST, qr.fetched_at DESC
                )
                SELECT symbol, period_end, revenue, pat, verdict, stage, trading_signal
                FROM latest_results
                WHERE trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
